description: Austrian Land letters used in place of the authority code on plates for the Landtag presidents, the members of the Landesregierungen and the Landesvolksanwaltschaften (KDV 1967 § 26 Abs. 3). The same nine letters are the base of the diplomatic/consular prefixes of § 26 Abs. 5 (see at-vertretungen). B, K, S and W are also Anlage 5d authority codes, but no ambiguity arises there: authority-code plates carry a Vormerkzeichen ending in a letter, while these carry digits only.
